name: DSH Achievement Journal
taglineZh: 把 DSH 运行中的小瞬间，收成一枚枚徽章。
hook: Give the agent loop a tiny milestone shelf.
description: A native Cordis plugin for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 that observes session events without inspecting payloads and exposes per-session achievement counters through /achievements.
features: Counts only event type and sequence
Chinese/English UI and reports; switching preserves current state
limitations: Event counts do not measure quality, productivity or safety
Only live events after plugin activation/reset are counted
In-memory counters reset on process restart or plugin reload
Web studio is an offline simulation, not a DSH dashboard
Targeted at DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; APIs may change
demoActions: Open ?lang=zh or use the language selector
Tap lifecycle events without losing counters on language change
Import a strictly ordered event sample
